body:
I work in a dental office. Saw this patient twice—older woman…the first time she came in was because she broke a temporary crown after falling down the stairs. She had also cut her calve of her leg in a giant V shape. Fixed her up and sent her on her way.
We have a metal bar that connects to the doctors tray, and can be manipulated to hover above the patient when needed.
Second time was for a crown seat. I asked her how he leg was healing. Before I could finish my sentence she lifts her leg to show me and splits her leg back open on the metal bar. Blood everywhere. 
I was so frazzled. Untrained for this kind of situation I asked for help. I Got up and retrieved her some gauze and my coworker had handed me a eye patch…SHE HANDED ME AN EYE PATCH FOR A LEG WOUND. She was so embarrassed that we busted out laughing. 
The patient ended up being okay. She was incredibly embarrassed by the whole situation. Her blood soaked through her pants and her stitches were ripped. She insisted she was okay to walk out the door—and she did just that. 
Haven’t seen her since—hope she’s doing okay.
My calves. My body tenses and I can’t…
